entries.german: Kraft von Hohenlohe und Ulrich II von Hanau geloben, die mit dem erzbischofe Heinrich III von Mainz geschlossene sühne wegen Rieneck und Bartenstein zu halten. Wir Kraft von Hohenloch und Ulrich herre zu Hanauwe irkennen offentlichen an desem bribe, daz wir mit dem erwirdegen fürsten, unserm hern, Heinrich erchebischebe (\!) zu Menze eine reitte ganze sůne han nach allen den dinge und stuche, alz zweiszen unz irgangen sint um Reneckin und Barttenstein und waz darzu horet, nach dem alz unsers hern vorgenant bribe besagent, di von wort zu wort hernach stent besagent, di he uns hait gegebin: Wir Heinrich von gotz gnaden des heilgen stules zu Menze erzebischof, des heilgen romischen ryches in duzen landen erzekancheler (\!) bekennen und viriehen offentlichen an desem bribe, daz wir um saliche ansprache, di wir von unser und unses stiftes wegen gehabit han und han wider di edeln . . lute Kraften von Hohinloch von montbarschaf wegen Ludwiges selegen graven zu Reneckin dotter, alz he sich virmiszet, und Ulriche hern zu Hanauwe umb Rienecke burg und stad halp, und waz darzu gehoret, und um Barttenstein daz hůz ganz, und waz auch darzu gehoret, daz von unz und unserm stifte zu lehene růret, alle di an-sprache sin gesohin, leicplich, gutlich und früntlich virsunet und virent darum also, daz di vorgenanten burge und stad Reinecke und Barttenstein und waz darzu horet, alz vorgeschrebin ist, unz und unserm stifte von Menze vorgenant gliche halp ane wedirrede und geverde bliben sullen und dem vorgenanten Krafte von der muntbarschaf wegen und Ulriche von Hanuwe daz ander halpdeil, der vorgenanten dotter an irme reitten unvirustlich, zu lehene von unz und unsem stifte, iz sie an . . luten, guten, geritten, wazzern, welden, weiden, irisecht und unsuchecht, we man finden oder nennen mag. Und zu findene und zu irfarne, waz zu den vorgenanten herscheften to gehere, daz von uns und unserm stifte růre, han wir von unser und unses stiftes wen zu eine irfarresmanne Wilderich von Vilmar, unsern vicedům zu Aschiffinburg (\!), und Kraft und Ulrich von eren wegen Rudolf von Weren und wir und si off bede siten zu eime oberman Conrad Schenken von Erpach gekorn und genomen, also bescheidenlich, daz di dri nach der zit, alz hernach beschrebin stet, riten sullent an alle di stad, da des noit ist, eine kůntschaf darvon zu irfarne darum an . . rittern, . . kneitten und an andern guden luten, alz reit ist und gewonlich ist; und waz di dri findent und besagent, ader zwene under en, daz zu den vorgenanten herschafte, burgen und stad zo gehorent und von unz und unserm stifte rurent zu lehene, daz sullen wir glich deilen, alz vorgeschrebin ist, und sullen und wollen uff bede siten wir alle, di zu der kůntschaf geheiszen werden, beitten und gebeiden, daz sie zu den heylegen sweren und eine kůntschaf uf den eit besagen darum, an argelist, und insallen auch den nummer di 25 viender werden. Ouch ist geredit um daz, daz wir en daz huz zu dem Bartenstein, und waz darzu horet, halp lazzen gevallen, daz si unz darum dinst důn sullent, den di strengen lute Conrat von Bickenbach und Eberhart von Rosenberg von unser wen, Conrat von Taume und Conrat von Bomersheim, ritter, von erer wen zu . . raitluden und so den edeln man grave Rudolf von Wertheim zu eine oberman of bede siten darober gekorn, alz sie gemeinlich under ein ader dri bescheidenlich und mogelich důnken. Und we si daz setzent ader machent, alz vorgeschrebin ist, daz sullent sie unz und unsem stifte důn und halten, an argelist. Geschehe auch, daz der vorgenanten raitlude 35 eheiner abegenge ader vor libes noit dabi nit moitte sin, ane geverde, wes dan der gewest werr, der sal dan einen andern gliche gůten an des stad setzen und gehin, ane geferde, innewendlich veinzehen dage, wan er des gemant wirdt. Were auch, daz der aberman keyner abegenge ader vor libes noit dabi nit moitten sin, alz vorgeschrebin ist, da sullent di . . raitlude, alz dan geboret, innewendich veirzehen dagen nach dem, alz si dan von unz des oder en gemant werden, in di stad zu Wertheim riten und nit daruon zu konene, sie inhaben dan eyn andern . . aberman gegebin, und der sal anch deselben mach haben, di der erste haitte, und sullen auch 5 der von beden siten beden und darzu halten, daz he sich es anneme. Dese sůne ist also geredit, daz wir sie stede sullen halten, abe unse . . kappittel zu Menze eren gunst und willen darzu dut und stede halden wollent mit unz. Were anch, daz derselbe cappittel di nit stede halden welden, so sullen wir ader sie nit virbinden zůn dit zo haldene, und geschehe sinen gunst darzu des kappittels (\!) ⁹), so sullent di vorgenanten . . raitlude und . . aberman, wan sie des von unz ader eu gemant werden, darnach innewendig veirzehen dagen off ere eyde di kuntschaf vorgenant anheben zu erfarne und zu follentforene und auch den dienst besagen, alz ir geboret und vor begriffen ist, 15 ane argelist. Und ist geredit, daz alle sache, alz hevor geschrebin stet, zutrath und irvarn werde, und abe unse cappittel sine gunst darzu nit indede, so sullent doch alle ding zweiszen unz allen, graven, frauwen und kinden von Rienecken, di wir in unse sune nemen, und en gutliche virliben stende glicher weiz alz hute deses dages zweiszen 20 he und sente Walpurg dag nest koinit. Und wer, daz dese sůne in dirre zit nit follentforet worde, alz vorgeschrebin ist, so sal und mag dan unser leglich sines reitten gebruchen und geneiszen ouch alz hute deses dages. Ouch ist geredit, ist, daz unse cappittel wil stede halden dese sůne, die hevor geschrebin ist, so sullen wir den vorgenanten 25 Kraften und Ulriche an den egenanten slozzen nach an den gůten, di en darzu gevallent, nit hindern, wan wir sullen sy forden. Ouch ist geredit, daz wir mit en einen burgfride sullen halden, alz gewonlich ist, in den egenanten slozzen und darzu ein virteil einer mile umb und um, ane geverde. Alle dese vorgeschrebin stucke und 30 ding han wir glabît mit guden truwen und zu den heylegen gesworn stede und feste zu haldene (\!) und darweder nit zu důne, uzgescheiden allerlei argelist und geverde. Des zu urkunde ist deser brip gegebin mit unser beider anhangenden ingesiegele zu Aschiffinburg (\!), des fritages vor sente Gallen dage, dů man zalte nach Cristus geburt 35 druzenhundert iar darnach in dem nůnunddrizigistem iare. Orig-perg. Das erste siegel (Hohenlohe) rund, braun, hängt beschädigt an, das zweite fehlt. München, reichsarchiv, Mainz, Erzstift. Gedr.: Wirdtwein, Nova Subsidia V 179. Des zu Urkunde han wir Erkenger von Sauwelsheim und Ebirhard Rudde vorgenant unser Ingesygel an dysem Bryf gehangen. Und ich Ebirhard von Rosenberg vorgenant bekenne dyse vorgeschrybin rede under hrn Erkengers und Ebirhartes Rüdde vorgenanten Ingesygeln, dy an dysen bryfe hangent, want ich mins eygen Ingesygels zu dyser Zyt nit en hatte. Gegebin an Sametztage nach dem zwylfften tage. Da man zalte nach Cristus geburte Druzchen hundert Jar und dar nach in deme zwey und funfzegesten Jare.
entries.english: Kraft von Hohenlohe and Ulrich II von Hanau vow to uphold the settlement concluded with Archbishop Heinrich III of Mainz concerning Rieneck and Bartenstein We, Kraft von Hohenloch and Ulrich, lord of Hanau, acknowledge openly in this letter that we have made a complete and proper settlement with the venerable prince, our lord, Heinrich, Archbishop (\!) of Mainz, concerning all the things and articles that have transpired between us regarding Rieneck and Bartenstein and what pertains thereto, according to what is stated in our aforementioned lord's letter, which is stated hereafter word for word, which he has given us: We, Heinrich, by God's grace Archbishop of the Holy See of Mainz, Archchancellor (\!) of the Holy Roman Empire in German lands, acknowledge and grant openly in this letter that we, regarding such claims that we have had and have on behalf of ourself and our foundation against the noble... people, Kraft von Hohenloch, on account of the wardship for the daughter of the late Ludwig, Count of Rieneck, as he claims, and Ulrich, lord of Hanau, for half of Rieneck castle and town and what pertains thereto, and for Bartenstein, the entire house and what also pertains thereto that is held as a fief from us and our foundation—all these claims have been reconciled in person, amicably, and in a friendly manner. And we settle it thus, that the aforementioned castles and towns of Rieneck and Bartenstein and what pertains thereto, as is aforewritten, shall remain with us and our foundation of Mainz aforementioned, equally in half, without contradiction or deceit; and to the aforementioned Kraft, on behalf of the wardship, and to Ulrich von Hanau the other half-part, of the aforementioned daughter, in their proper possession, as a fief from us and our foundation, be it in... people, properties, jurisdictions, waters, forests, pastures, rights sought and unsought, as one can find or name them. And to find and to ascertain what pertains to the aforementioned lordships that derives from us and our foundation, we have, on behalf of ourself and our foundation, chosen as an investigator Wilderic von Vilmar, our viztame at Aschaffenburg (\!); and Kraft and Ulrich, on their honor's behalf, [have chosen] Rudolf von Weren; and we and they on both sides have chosen and taken as an arbitrator Conrad Schenk von Erpach, so that these three, at the time as is described hereafter, shall ride to all the places where it is needed to conduct an investigation thereof by... knights,... squires, and other good people, as is right and customary. And whatever the three find and declare, or two among them, that pertains to the aforementioned lordships, castles and towns and derives from us and our foundation as a fief, that we shall divide equally, as is aforewritten. And we all on both sides shall and will await and bide those who are summoned for the investigation, that they swear by the saints and declare an investigation under oath, without deceit, and they shall also never become our enemies. It is also agreed, that we shall let them have half of the house at Bartenstein and what pertains to it, so that they shall perform service to us for it, which the stern men Conrat von Bickenbach and Eberhard von Rosenberg on our behalf, [and] Conrat von Taume and Conrat von Bomersheim, knights, on their behalf, as... councilmen and as the noble man Count Rudolf von Wertheim chosen as an arbitrator over it on both sides, as they may commonly, between one another or three of them, decide and deem possible. And as they set or make it, as is aforewritten, that they shall do and uphold for us and our foundation, without deceit. Should it also happen that one of the aforementioned 35 councilmen is absent due to departure or mortal peril, without deceit, whoever was present shall then place and admit another equally good man in his stead, without deceit, within fourteen days, when he is reminded of it. Should also the arbitrator be absent due to departure or mortal peril, as is aforewritten, then the... councilmen, as is appointed, shall within fourteen days after they are reminded of it by us or them, ride to the city of Wertheim and not depart from there until they have appointed another... arbitrator, and he shall also have the same power as the first had, and also the 5 on both sides shall ask and hold him to it, that he accept it. This settlement is also agreed that we shall hold it firm, if our... chapter at Mainz gives its favor and will to it and wishes to hold it firm with us. Should also the same chapter not wish to hold it firm, then we or they shall not be bound to uphold this, and should its favor be given by the chapter (\!), then the aforementioned... councilmen and... arbitrator, when they are reminded of it by us or you, shall thereafter within fourteen days, on their honor and oath, begin to conduct and complete the aforementioned investigation and also declare the service, as is appointed and understood by them, without deceit. And it is agreed that all matters, as are aforewritten, shall proceed and be investigated, and if our chapter should not add its favor to it, then all things shall nevertheless remain between us all, counts, ladies, and children of Rieneck, whom we take into our settlement, and a good peace shall stand between them, in the same way as it stands today between them and until St. Walpurga's Day next comes. And whoever should not fulfill this settlement in this time, as is aforewritten, then each may use and enjoy his rights also as of this day. It is also agreed that if our chapter wishes to hold this settlement firm, which is aforewritten, then we shall not hinder the aforementioned Kraft and Ulrich in the aforementioned castles according to the properties that fall to them, when we shall demand it of them. It is also agreed that we shall hold a castle peace with them, as is customary, in the aforementioned castles and thereto a quarter of a mile around and about, without deceit. All these aforementioned articles and things we have promised with good faith and sworn by the saints to hold firm and fast (\!) and not to act against them, all manner of deceit and guile excluded. In witness thereof, this letter is given with both our attached seals at Aschaffenburg (\!), on the Friday before St. Gall's Day, when one counted after Christ's birth 35 thirteen hundred years and thereafter in the nine and thirtieth year [1339]. Original on parchment. The first seal (Hohenlohe) round, brown, hangs damaged, the second is missing. Munich, Imperial Archives, Mainz, Archbishopric. Printed: Wirdtwein, Nova Subsidia V 179. In witness thereof, we, the aforementioned Erkenger von Sauwelsheim and Ebirhard Rudde, have hung our seals on this letter. And I, the aforementioned Eberhard von Rosenberg, acknowledge this aforewritten speech under the aforementioned seals of Lord Erkenger and Ebirhart Rüdde, which are hanging on this letter, because I had no seal of my own at this time. Given on the Saturday after the twelfth day, when one counted after Christ's birth thirteen hundred years and thereafter in the two and fiftieth year [1352].
